About the Academy

Educating people, empowering animal care, building trust.

Our Mission

To develop knowledgeable, responsible and skilled people who understand animal behaviour, welfare and humane care.

Our Vision

To build a community where people and animals live together with trust, safety, understanding and respect.

Our Promise

We focus on practical learning, responsible animal handling, ethical practices and understanding animals before attempting to train or manage them.

What we believe

At Royal Tego Paws Academy, we believe every animal deserves care, respect, understanding and a safe environment. Our mission is to educate people about responsible animal care and help aspiring professionals develop the practical knowledge and skills needed to work with animals.

Practical learning

  • Responsible animal handling practised with care and supervision.

Policies & FAQs

What are the fees and refund terms?

Fees, refund and course terms are shared during counselling and will be published here.

Is animal safety part of the training?

Yes. Responsible handling and animal welfare come first in every practical session.

Who can join?

Pet parents, aspiring trainers, grooming enthusiasts and anyone interested in animal care. Eligibility is listed per course.

Are the courses accredited?

Accreditation and approval details will be confirmed and stated here before publishing.
